contexts.text: Unclean things which titillate the fibres... DP 38:2.
Like soft threads of silk, which he loves because they titillate; but after death they become... prickly from the titillating things.
The pleasantnesses of the sense of touch are titillations.
Worms and little snakes which as it were crawl and eat, and thus cause a tickling and delight... SE 4466:end.
On a tickling and rubbing of the anus. Explained.
The love of self is a love purely corporeal, which springs from the boiling up and fermentation of the obsolete parts, and their titillation within the body. AE 1057:6.
